title: Northbeam TechWorks Membership Relief Credit Note: The Amount Written Off
content:
A write-off granted on the membership ground sets the membership's service credit against the charges standing unsettled on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job, and adds to it the share of the job's chargeable labour that the membership's own discount should have taken off. The two amounts together, rounded to the nearest cent, are the relief.

## 1. The labour figure and the surcharge figure

The labour the relief is worked out on is the labour standing on the job less the payments already received against it. That labour is taken into the share as it stands.

No part of a surcharge booked on that labour is taken into the relief.

## 2. The share

Nothing of that labour is taken into the relief. The share is applied to the labour figure and the surcharge figure added together, and the outcome is rounded to the nearest cent.

## 3. The credit

The credit available on the membership is the service visit credit its tier grants.

The credit the membership year still allows for service work is the service visit credit the tier grants less the credit already spent inside the window, and never below nothing.

The credit set against what is left is the lower of the credit available on the membership and the credit the membership year still allows for service work, so no redemption already netted out of the membership's own balance is deducted from that balance a second time.

The redemptions of the membership year are counted over the twelve months ending on the day the relief is granted, from the benefit redemptions booked on the customer's Northbeam Circle Membership.

## 4. The limit the relief stands within

The relief is rounded to the nearest cent and never exceeds the charges standing unsettled on the job, which are every charge booked on it less every payment received and every amount already written off, and it is never below nothing.

Read as a limit: the charges standing unsettled are a ceiling. Where the two amounts of clauses 2 and 3 come to less than that ceiling, the relief is those two amounts; where they come to more, the relief is the ceiling; and where they come to less than nothing the relief is nothing.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job or membership on file.*

A hypothetical job under TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration carries charges of 862.40 USD in all, payments of 316.00 USD received against it, and 73.20 USD already written off on it. Of those charges, 402.00 USD is labour. The customer's Circle membership stands on Circle Total Household Annual, a tier granting a service visit credit of 60.00 USD, and 14.60 USD of credit has been spent inside the window.

- The labour figure is the labour standing on the job, 402.00, less the payments already received, 316.00, which is 86.00 USD, taken into the share as it stands.
- The surcharge figure is nothing, no part of a surcharge being taken into the relief.
- The share is nothing, so the share applied to 86.00 and nothing added together gives 0.00 USD.
- The credit available is the service visit credit the tier grants, 60.00 USD. The credit the membership year still allows is 60.00 less the 14.60 already spent inside the window, which is 45.40 USD. The lower of 60.00 and 45.40 is 45.40 USD.
- The two amounts together are 0.00 and 45.40, which is 45.40 USD.
- The charges standing unsettled are 862.40 less 316.00 less 73.20, which is 473.20 USD. 45.40 is below that ceiling, so the relief stands at **45.40 USD**.
